    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Application
    Class with main() method as entry point for the Java VM.
    Article
    Class of a Article that can be ordered by a Customer.
    Calculator
    Calculator provides methods to perform calculations on objects of type Order and Order.Item.
    CalculatorDriver
    Driver-class to develop Calculator methods:
    Category
    Class describes the Category of an Article and defines the VAT tax classification (VAT: Value Added Tax).
    ClassToBuild
    The standard Builder pattern is used when objects of a ClassToBuild require multiple steps.
    ClassToBuild.Builder
    Builder class for the ClassToBuild that keeps state of the build process of an object-to-build (instance of the ClassToBuild).
    Components
    Public interface of system singleton components.
    ComponentsImpl
    Public singleton implementation class of interface Components that holds other singleton component objects as singleton instances.
    Customer
    Class of a Customer who can order Articles.
    DataFactory
    DataFactory provides factory methods to create objects of data model classes: Customer, Article and Category.
    DataFactory
    Public part of the implementation class of the DataFactory interface that provides creator functions of datamodel objects that are exclusively exposed to the DataFactory.
    Factory
    A Factory class provides create()-methods of objects of various types.
    Formatters
    Public accessor interface for various formatters
    Formatters.PriceFormatter
    Interface of a component with methods that formats prices.
    Formatters.TableFormatterFactory
    Interface of a component that provides factory methods for various table formatters.
    Order
    Class of what a Customer can order.

    OrderingSystemDriver
    Class with main() method as entry point for the Java VM.

    Public interface of system a component that stores objects of type <T> (or of sub-type <S>) indexed by an id of type <ID>.
    Singleton
    Class shows the implementation of the standard Singleton pattern in the lazy and the strict form.
    TableFormatter
    Formatter for tablular content.
